---
 For the Petitioners :- Mr. Kumar Rahul Kamlesh, Advocate
 For the Nhai :- Mrs Sweety Topno, Advocate
 For the Jiada :- Mr. C.A. Bardhan, Advocate
 ----
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, Jiada and Ntpc.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that land of the petitioners have been acquired by the
State

Government situated at mauza Konra, khata no.59, plot no.1484, area 1.43 acres and khata no.59, plot n.1487, area 2.77 acres total area 4 acres 20 decimals without following process of Land Acquisition Act.
3. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that said acquisition was made pursuant to Land Acquisition Case No.1 of 1992-93 which has been concluded and till date compensation has not been paid.

By way of referring annexure-6 he submits that said document is under signature of Land Acquisition Officer Hazaribagh wherein it is admitted that land was acquired for purpose of a project of RIADA and now for the purpose of NH-2 and compensation has not been paid.

4. Learned counsel for State, NHAI and JIADA jointly submit that dispute in question can be looked into by the respondent no.3.
5.

In view of above this petition is disposed of directing petitioner to approach respondent no.3 by way of filing fresh petition along with all credentials with regard to claim in question within two weeks, and if such a petition is filed, the Deputy Commissioner concerned will look into the matter and take a decision within four weeks
further thereafter decision taken by the concerned Dy Commissioner will be communicated to the petitioner.
6. This petition is accordingly disposed of.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/,
